data.title: Meadow Courier: Cozy Postal Village
data.summary: A cozy postal village kit with rounded cottages, delivery props, garden pieces and static woodland characters.
data.description: Build a small delivery game around a consistent honey plaster, teal roof and apricot accent palette. Architecture uses a 2 m placement grid; props have readable silhouettes and metre scale.

starterScene.title: Meadow Courier starter scene
starterScene.summary: A composed meadow courier scene with named objects. Use it as a starting layout for a web or mobile game.
starterScene.description:
A composed example built from the Meadow Courier kit. Each placed object has a named parent node for editing in three.js or Blender.

Uses metres, Y up and the pack's shared palette. This is a static environment layout. Individual models are also included in the pack. Collision meshes, navigation meshes, scripts and lighting are not included.

Part of [Meadow Courier](/packs/meadow-courier).

usage.modelViewer: <model-viewer src="https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/49/v1/model.glb" alt="Meadow Courier starter scene" camera-controls auto-rotate></model-viewer>
usage.blender:
# Blender 4.x: File > Import > glTF 2.0, or from the Python console after downloading the file.
import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/49/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)

assets.title: Meadow Courier Post Office
assets.summary: A compact teal roof post office with timber framing, parcel sign and letter slot for cozy delivery games.
assets.description:
A 2 m footprint postal building with closed front door, paired windows, carved envelope sign and projecting letter slot.

Measured bounds: 2.32 × 2.80 × 2.42 m (width × height × depth). One unit is one metre. Grounded origin at y=0, +Y up and front +Z. Static unrigged geometry. Architecture uses a 2 m placement grid; decorative roof overhangs may extend beyond the grid. Materials are shared within the Meadow Courier kit. CC0 original procedural geometry.

Part of [Meadow Courier](/packs/meadow-courier).

# Blender 4.x: File > Import > glTF 2.0, or from the Python console after downloading the file.
import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/43/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)
